title: Scripts and Testing Utilities
summary: This module contains various utility scripts and testing components for managing VCR cassettes, verifying CLI behavior, and validating cloud service integrations, particularly with Google Cloud's Vertex AI and GCS.

nodes.label: Parse VCR Cassette
nodes.title: Parse VCR Cassette
nodes.description: Parses a VCR cassette YAML file to inspect recorded HTTP interactions, optionally focusing on a specific interaction index. This utility helps in debugging and understanding network interactions captured during tests.

nodes.label: Run CLAI CLI
nodes.title: Run CLAI CLI
nodes.description: Executes the main command-line interface for the CLAI application. It handles argument parsing, command dispatch, and ensures proper exit codes, providing a direct user interaction point for various CLAI functionalities.

nodes.label: Verify CLI Help in README
nodes.title: Verify CLI Help in README
nodes.description: Tests if the `clai --help` output matches the expected content and updates the help section in `README.md`. This ensures documentation consistency and fails the test if the CLI help message changes unexpectedly.

nodes.label: Check Orphaned Cassettes
nodes.title: Check Orphaned Cassettes
nodes.description: Scans for VCR cassette files and compares them against VCR-marked tests to identify and report any orphaned cassettes. This helps maintain a clean test suite by flagging unused or outdated network recordings.

nodes.label: Upload Provider Test Files
nodes.title: Upload Provider Test Files
nodes.description: Uploads various test files to different cloud providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Bedrock. This script is crucial for setting up and preparing data for integration tests across multiple LLM platforms.

nodes.label: Verify Vertex GCS Access
nodes.title: Verify Vertex GCS Access
nodes.description: Verifies Vertex AI's ability to access and process files directly from Google Cloud Storage (GCS) URIs. It tests specific file types to ensure seamless integration and data handling within the Vertex AI environment.

nodes.label: Verify Vertex GCS All Types
nodes.title: Verify Vertex GCS All Types
nodes.description: Tests Vertex AI's capability to handle a comprehensive range of file types from Google Cloud Storage (GCS) URIs. This ensures robust support for diverse data formats when interacting with Vertex AI tools and models.

nodes.label: Test Vertex GCS Tool Result
nodes.title: Test Vertex GCS Tool Result
nodes.description: Performs detailed tests to ensure Vertex AI models can correctly process GCS URIs provided within function responses or as separate file data parts during tool calls. This validates the model's ability to interpret and utilize external data sources.

groups.label: CLI Management
groups.title: CLI Management
groups.description: Components related to the command-line interface and its documentation verification.

groups.label: VCR Cassette Management
groups.title: VCR Cassette Management
groups.description: Utilities for parsing and validating VCR cassette files used in testing network interactions.

groups.label: Cloud Integration Verification
groups.title: Cloud Integration Verification
groups.description: Scripts for uploading test data and verifying the integration and functionality of cloud services, especially Google Cloud's Vertex AI with GCS.
